title: Sneaky Phonk, Punk Panthers
style: dreamy pop, buồn, feliz, uk hardcore
lyrics:
Title: Sneaky Phonk, Punk Panthers (Extended Club Mix)
Genre: Punk Phonk / Dark Drift / Latin Hardcore
BPM: 195 (Aggressive, relentless bounce)
Vibe: Gritty, neon-lit streets, underground basement raves, raw distorted punk energy meeting blown-out 808s.

[0:00 - 1:30] EXTENDED DJ INTRO (THE DECODE)
The track opens with a low-passed, muffled 808 pulsing like a heartbeat. Sirens fade in and out, mixing with the sound of heavy boots on wet pavement. A clean, fast, intricate Latin acoustic guitar riff emerges. At 0:45, a blown-out, overdriven punk guitar power chord slides down the fretboard, abruptly cutting the Latin riff. A low, detuned cowbell begins hitting on the off-beats.

(Sampled, pitched-down vocal loop):
Sneaky phonk... sneaky phonk...
Punk panthers on the block...
Sneaky phonk... sneaky phonk...

[1:30 - 2:15] VERSE 1: ON THE BEAT
(Lead Vocal - Distorted, gritty shout with a high-speed rhythmic flow):
Step back, decode the road, the street is a mess
We are on the beat, on the street, ending the stress!
In the heat, in the night, we are not playing nice
Punk panthers on the prowl, we roll the heavy dice!
Not next week! You seek!
But we are too sleek!
Got the edge in the jaw, leave a mark on your cheek!
Hear the growl in the sub, feel the bass drop low
Delta strips on the dash, watch us go!

[2:15 - 3:00] THE CHONKY BUILD-UP
The 808s cut out. A raw, recorded punk drum kit does a massive, rolling snare build. The Latin acoustic guitar returns, heavily distorted, battling with jagged punk power chords.

(Vocal chant, escalating in volume):
Phonky. Chonky. Wonky.
Phonky. Chonky. Wonky.
Phonky! Chonky! Wonky!
PUNK PANTHERS GETTING WONKY!

[3:00 - 4:15] DROP 1: THE UNDER-STAIRS BRAWL
The sub-bass hits with massive intensity. Hyper-fast drift phonk cowbells create a chaotic, dissonant melody. Drums are a hybrid of a trap kit and a live acoustic punk kit.

(Pitched-down, harsh vocals):
UNDER THE STAIRS!
THEY ARE EVERYWHERE!
SNEAKY PHONK IN THE AIR!
UNDER THE STAIRS!
THEY ARE EVERYWHERE!
PUNK PANTHERS, WE DO NOT CARE!

[4:15 - 5:45] MID-SONG BREAKDOWN (THE LATIN TWIST)
Distortion drops. Reverb washes over the track. A slow, eerie Latin groove takes over. Guiro and congas mix with 808 trap snares for a stripped-back, atmospheric "Delta Strip" section.

(Whispered, sinister vocals):
Decode the road...
Watch the shadows fold...
Delta strips peel back, let the story be told.
You thought you were safe in the neon glow?
Panthers in the dark, moving real slow.
On the beat...
On the street...
In the heat...
Watch the Latin twist, watch the reality hit the concrete.

[5:45 - 6:30] VERSE 2: RELENTLESS PURSUIT
The BPM drives forward. The punk guitar returns with a rapid, muted chugging rhythm.

(Vocals - Fast, spitting, venomous):
Sneaky phonk, creeping up, never see us in the light
Got the fangs out, claws out, ready for the fight!
Not next week! Right now! We demand the crown!
Punk panthers in the alley, gonna burn the city down!
Phonky in the step, chonky in the heavy bass
Wonky in the brain when we stomp in the place!
Delta strips, Latin twists, snapping wrists, taking names
This is not a track, this is not a game!

[6:30 - 7:30] DROP 2: THE FINAL SLAUGHTER (EXTENDED CLUB DROP)
Four-on-the-floor hardcore kicks replace the trap bounce. The cowbell melody plays in a rapid-fire sequence.

(Chant loops, panning left and right):
Sneaky phonk! (Everywhere!)
Punk panthers! (Under the stairs!)
Chonky! Wonky! (Everywhere!)
Decode the road! (Under the stairs!)
Let the bass hit! Let the bass hit! Let the bass hit!

[7:30 - 8:30] OUTRO & DJ MIX-OUT
Elements strip away. Guitars fade into amp feedback. Cowbells echo into delay. All that remains is the low-passed 808 heartbeat and the acoustic Latin guitar playing the dark harmonic minor riff one last time.

(Final vocal sample):
...not next week. You seek. But they are sleek. Panther out.
